title: D-024 Amendment 14 unit T: shell-routing compatibility - empirical 2.1.251 routing proof under the live launch config, native-tool preference, pre-dispatch routing drift tooth
objective: Resolve the bashFirst / GitHub issue #88041 reconciliation gap (Amendment 14 R290/R291): the first live limited-auto run's worker proposed TWO PowerShell + ONE Bash read-only discovery commands instead of native Read/Grep/Glob (ASK-held, run_M0_T107_unitJ) and NO ledger task ever addressed that routing behavior. Deliver: (1) R292 - EMPIRICALLY prove how installed Claude Code 2.1.251 routes routine repository discovery and edits under the controller's EXACT live launch configuration (same build_argv + claude_child_env construction the certified start uses): bounded NON-FORWARDING live probes (deny-everything permission handler; every tool request recorded and denied; no file writes; 1-3 provider calls maximum) over canned discovery + edit assignments; record the measured tool-request stream in a version-keyed fixture. (2) R294 - native-tool preference in the WORKER PATH: explicit assignment/prompt guidance to use native Read/Grep/Glob/Edit/Write for repository discovery and editing, with required validation commands remaining explicitly classified and brokered via the documented_test_commands pattern - NO broker change, NO new AUTO class, NO classifier loosening. (3) R295 - PRE-DISPATCH routing drift tooth: dispatch fails closed unless current shell-routing evidence exists for the PINNED CLI identity (version-keyed fixture + probe in the S11.5 set); removal-sensitive tests. (4) Windows-shape classifier coverage check: map existing command-authority coverage for heredocs, pipelines/exit propagation, redirections, compound commands, scratch-file transfers, ambiguous effects; add ONLY missing ASK/HARD_DENY assertions (tests only - the classifier itself is untouched). PROHIBITED (R293): broadly allowing Python, PowerShell, sed, heredocs, redirections, compound commands, or arbitrary scripts; any owner-gate or broker weakening. SEPARATE unit (R296): own commits/evidence/reviews; its final identity joins the SINGLE M0-T119 recertification. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R291 (also AD-093: reproduced live shell-first ASK stops + inability to complete an authorized product task without owner touches).

Broker preservation: the classifier and policy tiers are byte-untouched; heredoc, pipeline, redirection, compound, scratch-transfer and ambiguous-effect shapes classify ASK or HARD_DENY exactly as before (coverage mapped; only missing assertions added).
